 FOOTBALL MLS Griezmann fails in his first attempt to overthrow Messi: Orlando City is already eliminated from the MLS
 The French forward bows out of the fight for the North American title after a harsh blow in the "play-in." His team suffered a painful comeback and left his great dream in ashes
 Orlando City SC forward Antoine Griezmann controls the ball in front of FC Cincinnati midfielder Obinna Nwobodo during the second half of a wild-card soccer match of the MLS Cup playoffs John Raoux 
 IVÁN CAMILO CASTIBLANCO
 Updated 20/11/2026

 Antoine Griezmann's North American adventure has suffered its first major setback . The French forward, who decided to cross the Atlantic last summer to make a radical change to his career after leaving Atlético de Madrid , saw his spell at Orlando City hurtling toward an abrupt and painful end. The dream of conquering the United States and challenging the absolute reign of figures like Leo Messi will have to wait until next season .
 The dream of the MLS has turned into a real nightmare for the former French international. Despite having signed a sensational few months since his arrival, with constant displays on the green pitch and a love affair with goals that captivated the fans, the competitive reality of the playoffs has sent him back to hell . The defeat suffered in the "play-in" tie has left the Florida side completely knocked out prematurely .
 For a born competitor like Griezmann , used to fighting for glory in the UEFA Champions League and at the summit of Spain's LaLiga, this setback is a major emotional blow . His main purpose in moving to the United States was none other than to leave his mark and win trophies , a goal that was suddenly brought to a halt in a match where things went wrong in the worst possible way for his team's ambitions .
 A promising start that came to nothing
 The decisive match began with the perfect script for Orlando City 's interests. The visitors came out with the knife between their teeth and managed to take the lead before the first half hour of play had elapsed , thanks to a great counterattacking move finished by Martín Ojeda . In that opening stretch, Griezmann's presence on the pitch seemed fundamental to channel the attacking play and keep the opponent's spells of possession at bay.
 However, the joy was short-lived for the visiting side. Just when the players were making their way to the locker room for the break, Cincinnati found the key to the equalizer thanks to a strict penalty kick in the 43rd minute . This psychological goal completely changed the dynamic of the clash, affecting the mood of an Orlando side that began to show unexpected defensive cracks at truly critical moments.
 The decisive blow after the teams came back out for the second half
 The nightmare fully materialized just after the match restarted. The 50th minute of the second half had not yet been reached when the Brazilian Evander once again pierced the opposing goal , scoring his personal brace and completing a comeback that left the entire Florida squad stunned. Griezmann tried to lean on his status and leadership, multiplying his efforts in the creative area, but the home side's defensive wall held firm against the Frenchman's desperate push .
 With Orlando throwing everything forward in search of a heroic comeback, the match finally broke open for good in the closing stretch. In the 85th minute, Samuel Gidi took advantage of the spaces left at the back to score the decisive 1-3 , putting the tie to bed and confirming the mathematical elimination of the Purples. While Cincinnati books its ticket to face the mighty Nashville, Griezmann and his teammates begin a bitter journey back home .
 Lights and shadows of a star signing
 Despite the collective blow, Antoine Griezmann's individual record in this first half of the Major League Soccer season remains outstanding. As various international media outlets point out, the forward ended his participation in the domestic championship with a formidable tally of 15 goals and 7 assists in just 23 matches played, a performance that recently earned him recognition as the best signing of the season in the competition.
 The big question mark now appearing on the horizon revolves around how the French attacker will manage this very long summer period and the planning of next season . At 35, the former Atleti player still has an undiminished desire to make history in North American football, aware that the great benchmark to look to remains Inter Miami of a Leo Messi who is still firmly in the race for the league title .
